UPDATE ${STD_TABLE} SET CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS = 38 WHERE ROWID IN (SELECT rwid FROM (SELECT S.ROWID rwid, m.flux_match_cd, ROW_NUMBER () OVER ( PARTITION BY S.document_id, M.SSN, M.hash_number ORDER BY m.document_id) rwnum, COUNT ( *) OVER ( PARTITION BY S.document_id, M.SSN, M.hash_number) cnt FROM ${STD_TABLE} S, ${STD_TABLE} M WHERE s.CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS = 5 AND M.ROWID != s.ROWID AND M.SSN = s.SSN AND M.hash_number = s.hash_number) WHERE flux_match_cd IN ('M', 'C_M', 'P_M', 'N_M', 'M_M') AND rwnum = cnt)
mapper.insert: insert into coded_display_file_name(FILE_NAME, DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE, DISPLAY_NAME, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATED_DATE) select ${fileName}, #{documentType}, ${fileName}, '900', SYSDATE from (select distinct ${fileName} from ${stdTableName} std where current_process_STatus = 5 and not exists (select 1 from coded_display_file_name where document_type_Code = #{documentType} and FILE_NAME = std.${fileName}))

WITH data AS ( SELECT job_id , To_Char(job_exec_start_dtm, 'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS AM') exec_start_date , To_Char(job_exec_end_dtm, 'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS AM') exec_end_date ,error_Desc FROM nyehms_sasdb_owner.er_audit_job_exec job_exec WHERE cycle_id = ( SELECT Max(cycle_id) FROM nyehms_sasdb_owner.er_audit_cycle where CYCLE_TYPE = #{CYCLE_TYPE} ) ) SELECT Distinct a.job_num, a.job_type, a.job_id, a.job_desc, b.exec_start_date, b.exec_end_date, nvl(b.error_Desc, '') error_Desc , CASE WHEN exec_end_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'PASSED' ELSE 'FAILED' END status FROM nyehms_sasdb_owner.er_audit_job a, data b WHERE a.job_id = b.job_id(+) and a.job_type like '%'|| #{CYCLE_TYPE} ||'%' ORDER BY a.job_num, b.exec_start_date
